## Before you hire anyone

- Get a written, itemized quote before authorizing repairs.
- Ask whether the service-call fee is waived if you proceed.
- Confirm the Nevada contractor license, parts warranty, labor warranty, and any after-hours surcharge.
- Get a second quote before agreeing to a full door or opener replacement.

You can verify a contractor through the [Nevada State Contractors Board](https://www.nvcontractorsboard.com/)\.
